MD4C 0.5.3, vendored from the official release-0.5.3 tag:
https://github.com/mity/md4c/tree/release-0.5.3

md4c.c and md4c.h are unmodified. See LICENSE.md for the MIT licence.
Fomawrite uses its own semantic HTML callbacks in publishinghtml.cpp to escape
unsafe raw HTML and reject executable URL schemes. No installed MD4C library
or dynamic dependency is needed.
